title: 2.1.5 Hello Sprite
description: Your first q5play sketch: a canvas, a sprite, a background color.

steps.title: Create a canvas
steps.instructions: Inside setup(), call `new Canvas(400, 400)` to make a 400×400 drawing area.
hints: Open the q5play docs drawer on the right and find the Canvas section.

steps.title: Make a sprite
steps.instructions: Create a sprite at the center: `player = new Sprite(200, 200, 40, 40)`. The four numbers are x, y, width, height.
hints: Check the Sprite section of the q5play docs drawer for constructor arguments.

steps.title: Color it
hints: Look up sprite properties in the q5play docs drawer.

steps.title: Paint the background
steps.instructions: Inside draw(), call `background('#222')` so you can see the sprite clearly.
hints: Search the q5play docs drawer for background().

requirements.title: Create a canvas
requirements.description: A canvas is created when the sketch starts.

requirements.title: Create at least one sprite
requirements.description: A sprite exists in the sketch.
